posts.title: Ohio Removes Suppressors and Short-Barreled Firearms From Its ‘Dangerous Ordnance’ List
posts.description: Ohio is taking suppressors and short-barreled rifles and shotguns off its dangerous ordnance list, but the change waits about 90 days and federal gun law still applies. #SOFREP #Ohio #Suppressors #SecondAmendment #NFA #2A
